why_ai: Serving process means a person at a door with a sworn affidavit, while the paralegal and search halves of the code are screen work that AI drafting and search tools now reach.
why_clarity: Served or not and accepted or rejected are clear outcomes, but drafting quality and search completeness show only weeks or months later.
why_digital: Papers and addresses come in digitally, but service is delivered in person and buyers often want a local server or preparer.

why_ai: The law still requires a human to hand papers to a person and swear to it; only routing and records automate.
why_clarity: A serve succeeds or fails and the return has fixed contents, though validity is tested rarely and late.
why_digital: Jobs arrive by portal and API, but the work is driving and knocking, and the deliverable is a physical act.

why_ai: Physical service survives, but volume buyers treat servers as interchangeable and the judgement content is low.
why_clarity: Near-identical serves at volume with codified affidavit contents and GPS-checkable records.
why_digital: Bulk uploads and device trails are digital, the serve itself is not, and filers dispatch nationally.

why_ai: Finding and serving an evasive person is adversarial, on-site and bought on the specialist's reputation.
why_clarity: Success is clear but each case is different and tactics are personal rather than written down.
why_digital: Skip-trace data is digital; stakeouts and serves are physical and buyers hire local specialists.

why_ai: Senior relevance judgement still matters, but AI semantic search and charting are substituting the first pass directly.
why_clarity: Search reports have a standard shape at volume, while whether a search was beaten surfaces months or years later.
why_digital: Patent and literature databases in, digital reports out, bought globally from offshore houses as a matter of course.

why_ai: Treaty channels run through foreign government authorities that AI cannot replace, though packaging and translation automate.
why_clarity: Each country's requirements can be written down, but completion is known only months after submission.
why_digital: Documents and translations are digital; service abroad and the returned certificate are physical, and buyers hire specialists remotely.

why_ai: Supervised drafting from templates is exactly what legal AI drafting tools target; the relationship with each attorney is the remaining moat.
why_clarity: Drafts follow court forms and attorney preferences, and the attorney's review time is a quick quality signal.
why_digital: Instructions, drafts and files move entirely by email and practice-management systems, mostly with local attorneys.

why_ai: Registration and bonding give some accountability, but consumer AI self-help and court guided interviews substitute form completion directly.
why_clarity: Court forms are fixed and filings are accepted or rejected quickly, though case outcomes come later.
why_digital: Forms are completed on screen, but customers come to storefronts in person and filings are often carried to the clerk.

why_ai: A registered agent's judgement on claim scope carries some protection, but inventors increasingly try AI patentability tools first.
why_clarity: Each invention differs and whether the search was right shows only at the examiner's first action years later.
why_digital: Descriptions and drawings in, search reports and filings out, bought online from agents anywhere.

why_ai: Envelope building, code selection and rejection handling are rule-bound screen work that e-filing software absorbs.
why_clarity: A clerk accepts or rejects within hours against codified requirements on thousands of similar filings.
why_digital: Documents in, electronic filings out, with occasional courthouse runs for courts that do not take e-filing.

why_ai: State law requires a physical registered office to accept service, but classification and deadline extraction automate.
why_clarity: Each document has a defined type and computable answer date at very high volume, and errors surface as defaults.
why_digital: Paper served at a physical office is scanned and handled digitally, with clients served nationally.

why_ai: Litigators pay for searchers who find the art that decides a case, a judgement AI search assists but does not yet own.
why_clarity: Invalidity reports repeat in form and are graded by public PTAB and court outcomes months later.
why_digital: Public patent and literature data in, claim charts out, bought from search houses worldwide.

why_ai: High-volume patentability searching is the work AI search tools target most directly; FTO claim reading keeps more protection.
why_clarity: Searches recur in standard form at volume, but quality is known only when an examiner or a dispute tests it.
why_digital: Searched online and delivered as reports to clients anywhere.

why_ai: Editorial abstracts face LLM summarisation, but normalised families, legal status and curated codes keep paying subscribers.
why_clarity: Every new record is abstracted and coded to a fixed scheme at huge volume and checked against source documents.
why_digital: Patent publications in, online databases out by subscription.

why_ai: Contract search to a fixed treaty format is the kind of screen work an office can automate or bring in-house.
why_clarity: International search reports follow a defined format and time limit, reviewed by the Office.
why_digital: Applications in, search reports out, delivered electronically to the agency.

why_ai: Judging which patents threaten members and when to challenge them is adversarial and relationship-led.
why_clarity: Threat assessment varies by campaign, though challenge outcomes are public within a year or two.
why_digital: Patent and litigation data in, analysis and filings out, sold by membership to companies worldwide.

why_ai: Statutory authority to grant or reject stays with examiners even as AI search assists them.
why_clarity: Examination follows the MPEP at enormous volume, but whether a decision was right surfaces years later in litigation.
why_digital: Applications and searches are entirely electronic and remote.

why_ai: Interview-driven document generation is direct AI territory, and general assistants now compete for the same customer.
why_clarity: Templates and interviews produce defined documents at very high volume with quick filing feedback.
why_digital: Customers buy, answer and receive documents online.

why_ai: Search software competes against general AI models and other vendors with no licensed human in the loop.
why_clarity: Relevance can be benchmarked against citations, though what counts as relevant is debated.
why_digital: Software built, sold and delivered online.

why_ai: Acquisition and integration judgement is deal-specific and sponsor-driven.
why_clarity: Each acquisition is different and results show over years.
why_digital: Financial and job data analysed on screen, with deals done through relationships.

why_ai: Physical service by contracted servers is required by law, while dispatch and records are commodity software.
why_clarity: Serves recur in near-identical form with device-checkable records.
why_digital: Orders and records are digital and national; the serve is performed in person by contractors.

why_ai: A physical registered office is a legal requirement, but intake classification automates.
why_clarity: Documents fall into defined types with computable deadlines at very high volume.
why_digital: Paper served at an office is scanned and forwarded electronically nationwide.

why_ai: Licensing and enforcement authority rests with public officials and will not move to software.
why_clarity: Audits and investigations vary and outcomes take months.
why_digital: Records are increasingly electronic, but licensing involves fingerprints, exams and local offices.

why_ai: Certification and community are relationship goods, though AI can generate exam and training content.
why_clarity: Exams and training recur on a cycle, with pass rates as a slow signal.
why_digital: Exams, training and directories delivered mostly online to a national membership.

why_ai: Enforcement authority and courtroom advocacy stay with accountable public lawyers.
why_clarity: Each enforcement matter is a case-specific judgement decided by a court.
why_digital: Case files are digital, but enforcement runs through courts and local offices.
